name: Kawasaki EX500 / Ninja 500R / GPZ500S 498 cc liquid-cooled DOHC 8-valve parallel twin, 180-degree crank (1987-2009)
summary: The 180-degree crank makes the two cylinders fire close together and then leave a long gap (180 then 540 crank degrees), giving a lumpy, off-beat idle that smooths into a hard-edged buzz as it revs to about 11,000 rpm. Two header pipes joined by a connecting pipe under the engine feed one silencer per side.

variant.value: Geometry and tuning data from the 2005 EX500-D12 (US Ninja 500) specification sheet; valve timing, cam lobe heights and exhaust layout from a German manual for the first-generation GPZ500S (EX500-A, 1986-on)
variant.note: The two generations share the engine (74 x 58 mm, 10.8:1, CVK34) in both sources; cam data was only found for the first generation.

cylinders.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. '4-stroke, Inline, 2-cylinder, DOHC, Liquid cooled, 8-Valve'.

layout.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Inline, 2-cylinder'.

bore_mm.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Bore x Stroke 74.0 x 58.0 mm'. Bucheli manual: 'Bohrung/Hub 74,0×58,0 mm'; cylinder bore 74.000-74.012 mm (p. 115).

stroke_mm.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Bore x Stroke 74.0 x 58.0 mm'.

rod_length_mm.note: Not found. The Bucheli manual's tables (pp. 113-116) give big-end bore (41.000-41.016 mm), crank pin diameter and side clearance but no centre-to-centre length; no other opened page states it.

compression_ratio.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Compression Ratio 10.8:1'. Bucheli: 'Verdichtung 10,8:1'.

displacement_cc.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Displacement 498 cc'. The Bucheli manual prints 'Hubraum 495 cm3' (https://drive.google.com/open?id=0B28GkOK3QDM-c2ZURGgyMGYzVFE); 74 x 58 mm x 2 computes to 498.9 cc, so 498 is taken.

firing_order.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Zylindernummer: links 1, rechts 2' and 'Zündfolge: 1-2' (cylinder 1 is the left cylinder, 2 the right; firing order 1-2). The Kawasaki spec sheets (https://cyclechaos.com/images/0/0e/EX500D12.PDF, https://cyclechaos.com/images/f/f7/EX500D6F.PDF) agree: 'Cylinder Number Method: Left to Right: 1-2'. Reading 1-2 with a 180-degree crank: the left cylinder (1) fires first, the right (2) follows 180 degrees later, then the long gap; that sequencing is derived, see firing_intervals_deg.

crank.value: 180-degree crank: the two crank pins are 180 degrees apart (one piston at TDC when the other is at BDC); a balancer shaft is fitted
crank.note: Wikipedia infobox, verbatim: '498 cc (30.4 cu in) liquid-cooled 4-stroke 8-valve DOHC 180º parallel-twin'. CycleChaos (https://cyclechaos.com/wiki/Kawasaki_EX500D), verbatim: 'liquid-cooled four, counter-balanced, 8-valve, dual chin-driven overhead camshaft 180° parallel twin'. Both are wiki pages; no factory manual page stating the pin angle was opened. The Kawasaki spec sheets (https://cyclechaos.com/images/0/0e/EX500D12.PDF and https://cyclechaos.com/images/f/f7/EX500D6F.PDF) print 'Firing Interval/Order 188°', which is taken to be a misprint of 180° (188 is not a possible even or paired interval). Balancer: Bucheli manual p. 115 lists 'Ausgleichwelle' (balancer shaft) bearing dimensions. General 180-degree behaviour at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Straight-twin_engine: 'In an engine with a 180 degree crankshaft, one piston rises as the other falls.'

firing_intervals_deg.note: DERIVED from the sourced 180-degree crank and firing order 1-2, not a figure quoted for this engine. General statement at the source, verbatim: 'the second cylinder firing 180 degrees after the first, followed by a gap of 540 degrees'. Sequence: cyl 1 (left) fires, cyl 2 (right) fires 180 degrees later, then 540 degrees to cyl 1 again. The only Kawasaki-document statement found is the spec sheets' 'Firing Interval/Order 188°' (https://cyclechaos.com/images/0/0e/EX500D12.PDF), an apparent misprint of 180°, which is consistent with a 180-degree first interval. No opened page states '180/540' specifically for the EX500, and none states explicitly that the left cylinder leads beyond the '1-2' firing order.

valves_per_cylinder.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. '8-Valve' twin. Valves are opened through rocker arms with screw adjusters ('Valve Clearance ... Adjustment Method: Rocker arm screw'; Bucheli lists 'Schlepphebel'), so valve lift is not equal to cam lobe lift.

intake_valve_dia_mm.note: Valve head diameter not found. The Bucheli manual gives only valve SEAT outer diameters, recorded separately as intake_valve_seat_od_mm.

exhaust_valve_dia_mm.note: Valve head diameter not found; see exhaust_valve_seat_od_mm.

intake_valve_seat_od_mm.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 (GPZ 500 S ab 1986), 'Mass- und Einstelldaten' p. 116. 'Ventilsitz: Aussendurchmesser Einlass 28,30 - 28,50 mm' (valve seat outer diameter, intake; midpoint recorded). This is the seat contact OD, a lower bound on head diameter, not the head diameter itself.

exhaust_valve_seat_od_mm.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 (GPZ 500 S ab 1986), 'Mass- und Einstelldaten' p. 116. 'Aussendurchmesser Auslass 24,00 - 24,20 mm' (valve seat outer diameter, exhaust; midpoint recorded).

intake_lift_mm.note: No source states valve lift. Only cam lobe height was found (intake_cam_lobe_height_mm); the valves are rocker-arm operated, so lift cannot be read off the lobe height without the base circle and rocker ratio.

intake_cam_lobe_height_mm.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 (GPZ 500 S ab 1986), 'Mass- und Einstelldaten' p. 116. 'Nockenwellen: Nockenhöhe Einlass 35,635 - 35,761 mm' (cam height, intake; service limit 35,55 mm). Midpoint recorded. This is total lobe height (base circle plus lift), NOT valve lift.

exhaust_cam_lobe_height_mm.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 (GPZ 500 S ab 1986), 'Mass- und Einstelldaten' p. 116. 'Nockenhöhe Auslass 35,635 - 35,761 mm' (service limit 35,55 mm). Midpoint recorded. Lobe height, not valve lift.

intake_duration_deg.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Ventilzeiten: Einlass öffnet 45° vor OT, Einlass schliesst 65° nach UT, Winkel 290°'. The lift at which this is measured is NOT stated; the very long duration suggests it is seat-to-seat or includes the ramps, so it is not comparable with timing quoted at 1 mm or 0.050 in. For scale, an aftermarket Web Cam grind for the GPZ 500 lists 272° advertised / 246° at 0.050 in (https://www.webcamshafts.com/pages_vehicles/motorcycle/kawasaki_install_data/tc_002918_000890.html).

exhaust_duration_deg.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Auslass öffnet 70° vor UT, Auslass schliesst 40° nach OT, Winkel 290°'. Measuring lift not stated.

ivo_btdc.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Einlass öffnet 45° vor OT' (inlet opens 45° BTDC). Measuring lift unknown (not stated). Corroborated by a forum post quoting 'my Kawasaki manual for the early GPZ500': 'Inlet: Open 45° BTDC. Close 65° ABDC. Duration 290°' (https://www.bikechatforums.com/viewtopic.php?p=1236022).

ivc_abdc.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Einlass schliesst 65° nach UT' (inlet closes 65° ABDC). Measuring lift unknown.

evo_bbdc.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Auslass öffnet 70° vor UT' (exhaust opens 70° BBDC). Measuring lift unknown. Forum corroboration (https://www.bikechatforums.com/viewtopic.php?p=1236022): 'Exhaust: Open 70° BBDC. Close 40° ATDC. Duration 290°'.

evc_atdc.note: Bucheli Reparaturanleitung Band 5136 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German workshop manual, first-generation GPZ500S/EX500-A), 'Technische Daten' p. 2. Verbatim: 'Auslass schliesst 40° nach OT' (exhaust closes 40° ATDC). Measuring lift unknown. Whether the 1994-on (EX500-D) cams have the same timing was not confirmed.

valve_clearance_mm.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Valve Clearance (Cold) Intake: 0.13-0.18 mm, Exhaust: 0.18-0.23 mm'.

redline_rpm.note: CycleChaos wiki page for the EX500D: 'Redline: 11,000 rpm'. Wiki source, no manufacturer document found; consistent with the spec sheet's full ignition advance being quoted at 10,000 rpm.

idle_rpm.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Idle Speed 1,050 ±50 rpm (US,CN), 1,250 ±50 rpm (CA)'. The same sheet quotes idle ignition timing 'at 1,200 rpm (US)'.

peak_power_kw.note: Enduro.team wiki page for the GPZ500: '60.0 h.p. (44.1 kW) at 9800 rpm' (full-power version, crank figure; 60 PS). Weak source (wiki, no manufacturer document opened for power). Other figures seen: CycleChaos (https://cyclechaos.com/wiki/Kawasaki_EX500D) '52 bhp @ 9500 rpm'; Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kawasaki_Ninja_500R) '49.9 hp (37.2 kW) (rear wheel)'; the German-market Bucheli manual lists a restricted '20 kW (27 PS) bei 8500 U/min' version.

peak_power_rpm.note: Same wiki line: '60.0 h.p. (44.1 kW) at 9800 rpm'.

peak_torque_nm.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Maximum Torque 4.7 kg-m at 8,500 rpm'; 4.7 kgf-m x 9.80665 = 46.1 Nm (converted). Same on the '06 EX500D6F sheet. Enduro.team: '46.0 Nm (4.7 kgf*m) @ 8500 rpm'. Other figures: CycleChaos '30.86 lb. ft. @ 8000 rpm' (41.8 Nm); Wikipedia '30.9 lb-ft (41.9 Nm) (rear wheel)'.

peak_torque_rpm.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. '4.7 kg-m at 8,500 rpm'.

ignition_timing.value: 10° BTDC at 1,200 rpm (idle), 37.5° BTDC at 10,000 rpm (full advance)
ignition_timing.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Ignition Timing - Idle 10° BTDC at 1,200 rpm (US) ... Full 37.5° BTDC at 10,000 rpm'.

intake_type.value: one carburettor per cylinder: two Keihin CVK34 constant-velocity diaphragm carburettors
intake_type.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet ''05 EX500-D12: Ninja 500' (General Specifications), hosted on CycleChaos. 'Carburetor: Keihin CVK34 (2) Constant velocity, Diaphragm-type'. Bucheli p. 116: 'Vergaser Fabrikat Keihin/CVK34', main jet 130, needle N36N.

throttle_dia_mm.note: No stated bore measurement found. The designation 'CVK34' implies a nominal 34 mm bore; that is an inference from the name, not a quoted dimension.

header_type.value: 2-into-2 with a connecting (crossover) pipe joining the two header pipes under the engine; one silencer per side
header_type.note: Bucheli manual p. 48, '7.6 Auspuffanlage'. Verbatim: 'Die Klemmbride des Verbindungsrohrs unter dem Motor lösen' (loosen the clamp of the connecting pipe under the engine) and 'Die Auspuffrohre am Verbindungsrohr verbinden'; the parts drawing (Bild 126) shows two header pipes, a cross tube between them and two silencers. First-generation bike. CycleChaos (https://cyclechaos.com/wiki/Kawasaki_EX500D) lists the EX500D exhaust as '2-into-2'.

exhaust_notes.value: Two separate header pipes linked by a connecting pipe under the engine, each feeding its own silencer (left and right). No dimensions found.

missing: intake_valve_dia_mm and exhaust_valve_dia_mm (only valve seat outer diameters found)
intake_lift_mm and exhaust_lift_mm (only cam lobe heights found; rocker-arm valvetrain)
the lift at which the 45/65/70/40 valve timing is measured

sources.what: Scan of the Bucheli Verlag Reparaturanleitung Band 5136, 'Kawasaki GPZ 500 S ab Baujahr 1986' (German-language workshop manual, 120 pages, ISBN 3-7168-1839-9), linked from https://en.enduro.team/Kawasaki_GPZ500:_manuals as 'Service Manual - Kawasaki GPZ 500 (1986-1994)'. Not the Kawasaki factory manual but a reputable third-party workshop manual built on factory data. Pages read as images: 2-3 (Technische Daten), 48 (exhaust), 66 (crankshaft), 115-116 (Mass- und Einstelldaten). Covers the first-generation GPZ500S (EX500-A), German market (27 PS restricted power figure).

Kawasaki one-page model specification sheet for the 2005 EX500-D12 Ninja 500 (General Specifications, Tuning Specifications, Model Identification with VIN range), hosted on CycleChaos. Text PDF, read directly. Appears to be Kawasaki dealer data; contains the '188°' firing-interval misprint.
Same Kawasaki specification sheet for the 2006 EX500D6F; identical engine figures including '188°'.
CycleChaos wiki page for the Kawasaki EX500D: 180° parallel twin, counter-balanced, redline 11,000 rpm, 2-into-2 exhaust, 52 bhp @ 9500 rpm. Wiki, unreferenced.
Enduro.team wiki page for the Kawasaki GPZ500: 60.0 hp (44.1 kW) at 9800 rpm, 46.0 Nm at 8500 rpm. Wiki, unreferenced.
Wikipedia, Kawasaki Ninja 500R: infobox '180º parallel-twin', 74 x 58 mm, rear-wheel power and torque.
Wikipedia, Straight-twin engine: general statement that a 180-degree twin fires 180 degrees apart followed by a 540-degree gap.
Bike Chat Forums thread in which a poster quotes his 'Kawasaki manual for the early GPZ500' valve timing (45/65/290, 70/40/290), matching the Bucheli manual. Forum; corroboration only.
Web Cam aftermarket GPZ 500 cam timing card (performance grind 245: 0.381 in lift, 246° at 0.050 in). Not stock; cited only for scale against the stock timing figures.

vehicle.name: Kawasaki Ninja 500R, EX500-D12 (2005 US model)
vehicle.chosen_because: The engine definition covers the EX500 / Ninja 500R / GPZ500S (1987-2009); the 2005 EX500-D12 has a complete Kawasaki model specification sheet.

curb_kg.note: Kawasaki model specification sheet, '05 EX500-D12, p1. The 2006 sheet (https://cyclechaos.com/images/f/f7/EX500D6F.PDF) is identical.

gears.note: Values here are the tooth-count quotients; each matches the printed decimal.

final_drive.quote: Primary Ratio 2.65 (27/23 x 63/28) Final Ratio 2.63 (39/15) Overall Ratio (Top Gear) 5.93
final_drive.note: My calculation from the tooth counts: (27/23 x 63/28) x (39/15) = 2.641 x 2.600 = 6.867. CONFLICT inside the maker's sheet: the printed decimals (2.65 x 2.63 = 6.970) do not match their own tooth counts, and the printed top-gear overall 5.93 follows the decimals (tooth counts give 5.85). Unresolved; tooth counts used because every gear's tooth count matches its decimal.

wheel_radius_m.note: My calculation, not published: unloaded geometric radius from the nominal size (rim diameter / 2 + section width x aspect ratio). The loaded rolling radius is a few percent smaller.

missing: top_speed_kmh: Kawasaki's sheet gives none. Second-hand only, not verified: CycleChaos (https://cyclechaos.com/wiki/Kawasaki_EX500D) cites a Motorcyclist test of 1994-on models at 118 mph; Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kawasaki_Ninja_500R) cites Motorcycle Consumer News at 110 mph (archive copy unreachable, HTTP 429).

sources.what: Kawasaki one-page model specification sheet, '05 EX500-D12 Ninja 500 (hosted by CycleChaos): weights, gearing, tyres.
Same Kawasaki sheet for the 2006 EX500D6F: identical figures.
